summary: PBF Energy subsidiary PBF Holding issued $550 million of 0% exchangeable senior notes due 2032 via Rule 144A private placement on September 17, 2026, including full exercise of the $50 million initial purchasers' option, yielding ~$533.6 million net proceeds. Proceeds fund capped call transactions, full redemption of the 7.875% senior unsecured notes due 2030, and general corporate purposes. Notes are guaranteed by eleven refining and services subsidiaries. The transaction is a routine financing and liability-management action rather than a special-situation event; watch for the exchange premium, capped call strike, and any conversion overhang affecting PBF shares.
